title: Dh\={a}r\={a} Bench: An Evidence-Oriented Retrieval Benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.03196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dh\={a}r\={a} Bench is a retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), with 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 text chunks from 15 source groups. The categories were developed based on 4,500 questions submitted to the Dh\={a}r\={a} application; the evaluation set combines corpus-aligned application queries with expert-contributed questions. The annotations comprise 7,578 question-chunk relevance links involving 6,847 distinct corpus chunks. For 34 composite and multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate groups specify alternative sets of passages that jointly support each question. Chunk identifiers and hierarchical references connect the judgments to their source texts. The paper describes corpus preparation, annotation, and validation, and reports a fixed BM25 baseline implemented with Pyserini with $k_1=0.9$ and $b=0.4$. translated_title: Dhārā Bench：面向印度知识体系的证据导向检索基准测试
translated_abstract: Dhārā Bench 是一个面向印度知识体系的检索基准测试，包含 12 个类别中的 325 个问题，以及来自 15 个源文献组的 60,121 个文本片段。这些类别是基于提交给 Dhārā 应用程序的 4,500 个问题开发的；评估集结合了语料库对齐的应用查询与专家贡献的问题。标注包含 7,578 个问题-片段相关性链接，涉及 6,847 个不同的语料库片段。针对 34 个复合和多跳问题，401 个共轭组指定了共同支持每个问题的多种替代段落组合。片段标识符和层级引用将相关性判断与其源文本相连接。论文描述了语料库准备、标注和验证过程，并报告了使用 Pyserini 实现的固定 BM25 基线（k₁=0.9，b=0.4）。在所有问题上，BM25 取得了 MRR@20 为 0.315、Recall@10 为 0.182 以及 nDCG@10 为 0.205 的成绩。在（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了 Dhārā Bench——首个面向印度知识体系的证据导向检索基准，包含 325 个多类别问题、60,121 个文本片段及 7,578 条相关性标注，并通过 BM25 基线实验揭示了该领域检索的挑战性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dhārā Bench, an evidence-oriented retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems with 325 multi-category questions, 60,121 text chunks, and 7,578 relevance annotations, revealing retrieval challenges through BM25 baseline experiments.
